survey: A crystal ball sits in a gold stand on a wooden shelf, against a green diamond-pattern wall. The camera is a little above the object. The shelf's top surface shows as a receding plane, its back edge meets the wall in a level line, and its front edge faces the viewer. The stand's round base is a stack of open ellipses with their tops showing, so it is seen from above, and it rests flat on the shelf top. A short neck rises from the base to a cup. The cup's rim is a flatter ellipse than the base, which is right because it sits higher and closer to eye level. The sphere sits in the cup. Two curved arms with ball finials rise from opposite sides of the cup's rim. The left arm joins the rim higher and sits at the ball's edge, so it is the one further back. The right arm joins lower and crosses in front of the glass, so it is the nearer one. Together they place the arms on a slightly turned circle that matches the rim's ellipse. Verticals stay vertical, the swirl and highlight on the sphere follow its round shape, and the base, cup, arms and shelf all agree on one viewpoint seen a little from above.
